name: suite-dispatcher
description: 技能总调度：以 BUSINESS-FLOW-MAP 业务流程为路由表，按需读取 ~/.workbuddy/skills 下约 140 个自建技能并执行，无需用户记忆技能名。

displayDescription.en: Routes your request along business flows and loads only the skills needed, so you never memorize skill names.
displayDescription.zh: 用业务流程驱动，按需读取你的 140 个自建技能，说业务目标就自动分派执行，无需记技能名。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我现在要做的业务是：（一句话说清目标），帮我判断该走哪条流程、用哪些技能。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Here is the business goal in one line — tell me which flow to follow and which skills to use.

quickPrompts.en: Here is the business goal in one line — tell me which flow to follow and which skills to use.
quickPrompts.zh: 我现在要做的业务是：（一句话说清目标），帮我判断该走哪条流程、用哪些技能。

quickPrompts.en: I have a problem but don't know which method or skill fits — diagnose it for me.
quickPrompts.zh: 我遇到一个问题，不知道用哪个方法/技能解决，你帮我判断一下。

quickPrompts.en: Walk me through a full change request process and produce the change request document.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我把这次变更走完变更流程，并输出变更请求。
